A third-party completion estimate is on file, but this entry is not officially confirmed: HDB has not verified a project-wide key date, and tracker sources have disagreed on the month. Unit counts and any estimated month are left out of the facts below. The words “Garden” and “Waterfront” are not treated as a confirmed outlook. If you have an HDB key letter, use that. This page sets out what is on file and how to plan your Garden Waterfront I & II @ Tengah renovation.

sections.heading: Planning your Garden Waterfront I & II @ Tengah interior
sections.text:
Tengah’s plantation and garden district is still taking shape, and a first fit-out here has to work from week one: a fitted kitchen, full-height wardrobes, an entry shoe cabinet, and a living-room storage wall, designed as built-in carpentry rather than as loose, flat-pack furniture. Maison can present that work in a wide room view or in closer material studies. We have no official floor plan on file and will not invent typologies, a typical layout, or a water view from your future block.

Plantation Creek @ Tengah and Plantation Verge are the other Tengah pages in this batch; both are also unconfirmed for keys. Keat Hong Grange and Heart of Yew Tee sit in neighbouring Choa Chu Kang. Use those as internal links, not as a shared typologies list or a shared handover date. We will not invent walking times to any present or future MRT station, and we will not treat the I and II label as two confirmed key dates.

After keys, inspect defects, measure, and apply for the HDB renovation permit before fabrication. A moderate, non-structural carpentry scope is often planned at about six to ten weeks on site after access and approvals — an editorial allowance, not a guarantee. WhatsApp Maison with your approved plan and any key letter you have. We are not affiliated with HDB.
